data.name: Shrunk Wilds
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Shrunk Wilds – an open-world survival RPG set in a vast miniature world.

Gather resources, build your own base, craft tools, weapons, and equipment, and explore a living world filled with mysteries, unusual creatures, and hidden locations.

Journey through meadows, forests, ponds, playgrounds, frozen regions, and many other unique environments. Build your home, upgrade your equipment, raise companions, and discover new resources and challenges along the way.

But the farther you travel from the familiar lands, the stranger the world becomes. Familiar places begin to change, mysterious memories emerge, and the line between fantasy and reality slowly starts to blur.

Features:

• Explore a vast open world
• Base building and free-form construction
• Resource gathering and crafting
• Companions and pets
• A variety of unique biomes
• Bosses, secrets, and hidden locations
• Character progression and equipment system
• A story filled with memories, mysteries, and discovery

A Big Adventure In A Tiny World.
